title: Release archival / retention policy evidence
description: Records the team's release artifact archival/retention policy. Consumed by RELEASE-ARCHIVE-063 (closes NIST SSDF PS.3 GAP and aligns EU CRA 10-year retention). Place at .oss-policy-kit/evidence/release-archival-policy.json.

retention_years.description: Number of years release artifacts and security documentation are retained. EU CRA expects >= 10.

archive_destination.description: Where artifacts are archived. Examples: github-releases, s3://bucket, swh:archive, azure-blob://container.

vulnerability_handling_doc.description: Path or URL to the vulnerability-handling process document (e.g. SECURITY.md).

swhid.description: Optional Software Heritage IDentifier for source archival. ISO/IEC 18670.

policy_owner.description: Owner team or distribution list for the archival policy.
